prompts.prompt: What do you hope to study, and why, at CU Boulder? Or if you don't know quite yet, think about your studies so far, extracurricular/after-school activities, jobs, volunteering, future goals or anything else that has shaped your interests.

intl_finance.document: Evidence of full financial support for all first-year expenses (proof of funding) plus a completed Financial Statement / Affidavit of Support
intl_finance.notes: Admissions says it is needed if the student is academically eligible and needs a Form I-20 or DS-2019, and that it must be received before CU Boulder can finalize the admission and issue the immigration form. The I-20 is emailed after Admissions has received and reviewed the proof of funding, the Financial Statement / Affidavit of Support, proof of English proficiency and a passport scan. The specific accepted document types, validity period and any due date are not on the admissions pages read.

notes: One required 250-word short answer on top of the Common App essay (250-650 words); it must differ from the Common App essay. The First-Year Apply page shows no year; the 2027 application-season guide (source 4) confirms the same two-part essay requirement (Common App essay plus a 250-word academic interest question), so the cycle is set to 2026-27. Music applicants also complete a separate College of Music application, which is not covered here. Exact financial document list and deadlines were not found on the admissions pages (source 3 also describes the I-20 steps).
